analysis.reason: RSI 33.9에서 47.9로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램도 개선세. 5일 연속 관망 유지하며 축적 구간 진행 중. ADX 16.1로 추세 미형성 상태. 5일 저가 151.35 대비 현재가 155.75로 Higher Low 패턴 형성 중. 매수 진입은 SMA20 돌파 및 거래량 동반 확인 필요.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 33.9 to 47.9, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram also shows improvement. Maintaining a wait-and-see stance for 5 days, progressing through an accumulation phase. ADX at 16.1 indicates a lack of trend formation. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the current price of $155.75 compared to the 5-day low of $151.35. Entry requires confirmation of breaking above SMA20 with accompanying volume.

· 현재가($155.75) vs SMA5/20/50($154.96/$156.15/$158.01): 단기 하회, 중기 상회, 중기 저항 구간
· SMA100/200($157.76/$152.65) 대비 위치: 중장기 추세 상회, 중장기 지지선 상회 강도
· 52주 위치(76.0%) + 현 가격대 역사적 고점 대비 하락 구간
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (33.9→47.9) + 과매도탈출, 중립 구간 회복 중
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.3704→0.0628) + 개선, 바닥 다지기 신호
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (상단 $159.91/중단 $156.15/하단 $152.39): 중단 근처, 밴드폭 4.82%로 축소
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($154.26) + 근거 (피벗 S1 $151.71, SMA200 $152.65 기반)
· 스윙 저항선 ($156.42) + 돌파 시 SMA20 저항 구간 진입
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low 형성 중) + 회복 신호
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.80배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 위축
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 진입 조건: SMA20 돌파 및 거래량 동반 확인
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($155.75) vs SMA5/20/50 ($154.96/$156.15/$158.01): below short-term, above mid-term, testing mid-term resistance.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($157.76/$152.65): above long-term trend, strength above long-term support.
· 52-week position (76.0%) + current price range in a decline from historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (33.9→47.9) + exiting oversold, recovering towards neutral.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.3704→0.0628) + improving, bottoming signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $159.91/Middle $156.15/Lower $152.39): near the middle band, with a band width of 4.82% narrowing.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($154.26) + basis (Pivot S1 $151.71, SMA200 $152.65 based).
· Swing Resistance ($156.42) + breaking above leads to testing SMA20 resistance zone.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low forming) + recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.80x) + reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + entry condition: confirmation of breaking SMA20 with accompanying volume.

analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 4 consecutive trading sessions. Today, RSI exiting oversold and MACD improvement strengthened buy signals, but the trendless ADX and subdued volume warrant continued observation. A shift to buying will be considered upon a break above SMA20.
